data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the M-Bus master (e.g., your EthMBus-XL device)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {name}
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your M-Bus master. The connection will be tested before saving changes.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the M-Bus master

user.title: Add or search for M-Bus meters
user.description: You can either a meter by specifying its address manually or select it from the search results after searching for meters on the bus. Searching may take a while. Search results are cached so you can add multiple meters from the same search.

address.title: Add meter based on address
address.description: The bus address is a number between 1 and 250 that identifies the meter on the M-Bus. You can't add meters again that have already been added.

select.title: Select meter from search results
select.description: Found {total_meter_count} meters connected to {master_name} with {addable_meter_count} of them not added yet. {bus_searched_count} out of {total_bus_addresses} addresses have been scanned so far.

search.title: Search for meters
search.description: You are about to search for meters on the bus. You can limit the search to a specific range of addresses to speed up the process. The search will take some time to complete.

data_description.start_address: Searching will start at this address. Must be equal to or smaller than the end address.
data_description.end_address: Searching will end at this address. Must be equal to or greater than the start address.

no_search_yet.title: Nothing to select
no_search_yet.description: You have not performed a search for meters yet. Start a search to discover meters on the bus.

nothing_found.title: No meters found
nothing_found.description: No meters were found on the bus. If you haven't searched the entire address range yet, you could try searching again to see if there are any meters at other addresses.

nothing_available.title: No meters available
nothing_available.description: All found meters have already been added. You could try searching again to see if there are any new meters on the bus.

add_meter.title: Adding meter
add_meter.description: Add a meter to {master_name} based on its address on the bus.

data_description.name: Friendly name for the meter (leave empty to auto-generate)

abort.nothing_to_add: No meter found at this bus address.
abort.already_configured: The meter at this bus address has already been added to Home Assistant.

error.no_meter_selected: You must select a meter first before you can add it.
error.start_before_end: Start address must be less than or equal to end address.
error.end_before_start: End address must be greater than or equal to start address.
